offering_description.value: Sells a unified customer experience management software platform to large enterprises, letting them manage social media, customer care, marketing and listening data in one system. It is delivered as cloud software on a subscription basis, with implementation and support services.

primary_products.value: customer experience management software; social media management; customer care software; marketing software; social listening and research

primary_services.value: implementation and consulting; managed services; training and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises in consumer goods, financial services, healthcare, retail, telecom and travel

end_markets.value: consumer goods; financial services; healthcare; retail; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or multi-year software licenses for the cloud platform and its modules; service fees: implementation, consulting, managed services and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells its own cloud platform to enterprise brands and marketing and service teams; service provider: implements and manages the platform for enterprise customers

geography_served.value: global: customers across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: several modules on one platform: social media, customer care, marketing, research and listening

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large brands; partners / resellers: technology and agency partners and cloud marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR and CCPA, plus customer requirements in regulated sectors

notes: Customer and channel details are based on general knowledge of the company and may not reflect current offerings.
